Brand strategy and identity guidelines

Sapentine Interior Decor

Let the finish lead.

The starting point

Let the finish lead.

Sapentine’s work spans the top of a room, the ground beneath it and the details around a building. The brand needed a way to hold those services together while keeping the actual craft in view.

The work covered

  • Brand essence and positioning
  • Messaging and service structure
  • Logo, palette and typography guidance
  • Digital, stationery and on-site applications

The decisions

A reason for
the choices.

‘Above and underfoot’ connects the service range in a line people can picture. Brass, plaster, charcoal and stone take their cues from the spaces themselves. The gold S emblem adds a signature without competing with the project photography.

  • #242624
  • #F4F0E8
  • #B58A46
  • #D7CBBB

The words

A fine finish. Above and underfoot.

The headline has character; the service line beneath it does the explaining. POP ceilings, floor stamping, artwork and parapet remain easy to find.
